Use case: Vandrheim RPG game HUD action icon. Asset type: standalone 2D UI icon.
Style: Match the project's micromenu and Close component: clean illustrated fantasy-game icon, bold dark charcoal outline, warm brass gold and amber #C89445, parchment cream #F4EDE0, charcoal #292A2E; restrained flat shading and a subtle shallow bevel. Strong, readable silhouette at 24–32 px.
Composition: One compact eight-tooth cogwheel for Settings, viewed straight-on. A dark charcoal center hub with a small parchment-cream circular center, gold metal face and a few broad simple bevel planes. Centered, complete silhouette fills about 78% of a square canvas with generous even transparent margins.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background; clean alpha edges. No background, tile, border, text, letters, numbers, extra symbols, tiny details, photorealism, 3D render, glow, particles, gritty texture, or drop shadow. One icon only.
